title: Session on a non-Claude model with a small context window fails every turn once full after 2.1.323
symptoms: Every turn errors after a long conversation on a third-party model
Context overflow errors that only clear after /clear
cause: From 2.1.323, a model ID that Claude Code does not recognize is assumed to have a 1M context window instead of 200K. On models with a smaller real window, the session grows past the limit before compaction runs.
fix: Force the 200K assumption with the environment variable, or lower the compaction point with /autocompact, before the session fills.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.323 and later with unrecognized model IDs, such as other vendors' models behind a gateway
